Also CE=CD, so triangle CDE is an isosceles triangle, ∠CDE=∠CED=(180°-50°)/2=65°. Similarly, F is on AB and D is on BC, therefore ∠DBF=∠CBA=50°; also BF=BD, so triangle BDF is an isosceles triangle, ∠BDF=∠BFD=(180°-50°)/2=65°. At point D, DC and DB form a straight line, so the sum of the adjacent upper angles ∠CDE, ∠EDF, and ∠FDB is 180°. Therefore ∠EDF=180°-65°-65°=50°.

method.method_draft: Angle-chasing with the two small isosceles triangles. From the text/image, note that ABC is isosceles with AB=AC and vertex angle A=80°, so the base angles at B and C are each 50°. Since E lies on AC and D lies on BC, angle ECD equals angle ACB, so it is 50°. With CE=CD, triangle CDE is isosceles, giving angles CDE=CED=(180°-50°)/2=65°. Similarly, since F lies on AB and D lies on BC, angle DBF equals angle CBA=50°, and with BF=BD, triangle BDF is isosceles, so BDF=BFD=65°. At point D on the straight line CB, the adjacent angles CDE, EDF, and FDB sum to 180°, hence EDF=180°-65°-65°=50°.

method.method_draft: Coordinate/trigonometric direction method. Place C=(0,0), B=(1,0), with BC horizontal. Since ABC is isosceles with A=80°, the rays CA and BA make 50° angles with BC. Let D=(t,0). Because CE=CD=t and E lies on ray CA, E=(t cos50°, t sin50°). Because BD=1-t and BF=BD with F on ray BA, F=(1-(1-t)cos50°, (1-t)sin50°). Then vector DE=t(cos50°-1, sin50°), whose direction from the positive x-axis is 180°-arctan(sin50°/(1-cos50°))=180°-65°=115°. Vector DF=((1-t)(1-cos50°), (1-t)sin50°), whose direction is arctan(sin50°/(1-cos50°))=65°, using sinθ/(1-cosθ)=cot(θ/2). Therefore the angle between DE and DF is 115°-65°=50°.
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示三角形 ABC 的底边 CB 水平，A 在上方，D 在 BC 上，E 在 AC 上，F 在 AB 上，并且线段 DE、DF 分别从 D 连到两腰上的点 E、F。推理：因为 AB=AC 且 ∠A=80°，所以底角 ∠B=∠C=(180°-80°)/2=50°。按指定坐标法，取 C=(0,0), B=(1,0)，令 D=(t,0)。由于 CE=CD=t 且 E 在从 C 到 A 的方向上，该方向与正 x 轴成 50°，所以 E=(t cos50°, t sin50°)。由于 BD=1-t 且 BF=BD，F 在从 B 到 A 的方向上，该方向相当于从 B 出发向左上方，与水平线成 50°，所以 F=(1-(1-t)cos50°, (1-t)sin50°)。于是 DE=E-D=t(cos50°-1, sin50°)，其方向角为 180°-arctan(sin50°/(1-cos50°))。用恒等式 sinθ/(1-cosθ)=cot(θ/2)，得 sin50°/(1-cos50°)=cot25°=tan65°，所以 DE 的方向角是 180°-65°=115°。同理 DF=F-D=((1-t)(1-cos50°), (1-t)sin50°)，其方向角为 arctan(sin50°/(1-cos50°))=65°。因此 ∠EDF 是两方向角之差：115°-65°=50°。
